summary: Describes playbooks as human-readable records of configuration, deployment and orchestration, from basic config management to multi-tier rolling updates with delegation to monitoring and load balancers.
questions: What can playbooks do beyond configuration management?
Are playbooks meant to be human readable?

answer_card.title: What playbooks are for
answer_card.answer_md: Playbooks record and execute configuration, deployment and orchestration. They can describe a policy for remote systems or a sequence of IT steps, from simple config management to multi-tier rolling updates that delegate to monitoring servers and load balancers. They're written in a human-readable text format.
